tips.label: 問天氣
tips.text: 用 How is/was the weather ...? 或 What is/was the weather like ...? 來問天氣。

tips.label: 回答天氣
tips.text: 用 It is/was + 天氣形容詞回答，例如 It was rainy. 注意這裡用 It，不用 This 或 That。

tips.label: 易混淆句型
tips.text: It snows/snowed 的 snow 是動詞；It is/was snowy 的 snowy 是形容詞。There is/was + rain/snow 與 We/They have/had + rain/snow 都能表示某地有雨雪，但主詞與動詞不可混搭。

notes.title: How 與 What 詢問天氣
notes.rule: How + be 動詞 + the weather + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？／What + be 動詞 + the weather + like + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？
notes.description: How 的問句不能加 like；What 的問句一定要加 like。be 動詞依時間改成 is 或 was。
examples: How is the weather in Taipei today?
What was the weather like in Hsinchu last night?
How was the weather in Australia in summer?

notes.title: 回答天氣狀況
notes.rule: It + is / was + 天氣形容詞。
notes.description: 談天氣時用代名詞 It 代替 the weather。今天、現在等現在時間用 is；昨天、上週等過去時間用 was。
examples: It was rainy and wet yesterday.

notes.title: 描述雨量與雪量
notes.rule: It + rains/rained/snows/snowed + a lot/a little + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這個句型是動詞；現在習慣或事實用 rains/snows，過去發生的事用 rained/snowed。snowy 是形容詞，必須搭配 It is/was snowy，後面不能再直接接 a lot 或 a little。
examples: It rains a lot in Taipei in winter.
It snowed a little in the mountains yesterday.

notes.title: There is/was 與 have 描述雨雪
notes.rule: There + is/was + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。／We/They + have + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這裡是不可數名詞，不能說 many rains。There 開頭要搭配 is/was；We/They 開頭要搭配 have/had。問句分別是 Is/Was there ...? 與 Do/Did we/they have ...?，兩套句型不可混搭。
examples: There was a lot of rain last summer.
We have much rain in spring.
They had a little snow in January.

quiz.question: ___ is the weather in your town now?
quiz.hint: 沒有 like 的天氣問句用 How is the weather。

quiz.question: ___ is the weather like near the sea today?
quiz.hint: 有 like 的天氣問句用 What is the weather like。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather in the mountains yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去；weather 是不可數名詞，搭配 was。

quiz.question: What ___ the weather like outside right now?
quiz.hint: right now 表示現在；weather 搭配單數 is。

quiz.question: What was the weather ___ in your town last night?
quiz.hint: What was the weather like 是詢問過去天氣的句型；like 在此不作動詞變化。

quiz.question: A: How is the weather now? B: ___ is warm and sunny.
quiz.hint: 回答天氣時用 It 作主詞。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather near the river last Sunday?
quiz.hint: last Sunday 是過去時間，the weather 搭配 was。

quiz.question: ___ was the weather like on your trip yesterday?
quiz.hint: 問句含 like，開頭用 What。

quiz.question: A: How was the weather yesterday? B: It ___ windy and cold.
quiz.hint: 昨天的天氣用過去式；It 搭配 was。

quiz.question: It is ___ outside now. Take an umbrella.
quiz.hint: is 後接天氣形容詞 rainy。

quiz.question: It was ___ near the sea last night.
quiz.hint: was 後接天氣形容詞 windy。

quiz.question: It is ___ in the mountains this morning.
quiz.hint: is 後面用形容詞 snowy 描述天氣。

quiz.question: It was ___ over our town yesterday.
quiz.hint: was 後用形容詞 cloudy 描述多雲的天氣。

quiz.question: A: What is the weather like now? B: It ___ cool and dry.
quiz.hint: now 表示現在；It 後用 is 接形容詞。

quiz.question: A: What was the weather like last winter? B: ___ was very cold.
quiz.hint: 描述天氣用 It，不用人稱代名詞 We 或 You。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot in this country every spring.
quiz.hint: every spring 表示習慣；主詞 It 用 rains。

quiz.question: It ___ heavily in our town last Monday.
quiz.hint: last Monday 表示過去，下雨用 rained。

quiz.question: It ___ a little in these mountains every winter.
quiz.hint: every winter 表示習慣；It 後用 snows。

quiz.question: It ___ all night in the mountains yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，下雪用 snowed。

quiz.question: Does it ___ a lot near the sea in summer?
quiz.hint: Does 後面的動詞用原形 rain。

quiz.question: Did it ___ in your town last night?
quiz.hint: Did 後面的動詞用原形 snow。

quiz.question: It does not ___ much here in autumn.
quiz.hint: does not 後接原形動詞 rain。

quiz.question: It did not ___ here last Christmas.
quiz.hint: did not 後接原形動詞 snow。

quiz.question: ___ it rain a lot here every summer?
quiz.hint: 描述習慣，主詞 it 的一般動詞問句用 Does。

quiz.question: ___ it snow in the mountains yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去；一般動詞 snow 的問句用 Did。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of rain outside right now.
quiz.hint: There 後接 be 動詞；rain 不可數，現在用 is。

quiz.question: There ___ a little snow on the road last night.
quiz.hint: There 後接 be 動詞；snow 不可數，過去用 was。

quiz.question: We ___ a lot of rain here every autumn.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 描述某地的雨量，用 have 加 rain。

quiz.question: Our town ___ a lot of snow every January.
quiz.hint: Our town 是第三人稱單數，現在式用 has。

quiz.question: They ___ a lot of rain in their town last weekend.
quiz.hint: last weekend 表示過去，have 的過去式是 had。

quiz.question: ___ there any snow on the mountain right now?
quiz.hint: snow 不可數；現在的 there be 問句用 Is there。

quiz.question: ___ there much rain here last summer?
quiz.hint: rain 不可數；過去的 there be 問句用 Was there。

quiz.question: Do you ___ much rain here in spring?
quiz.hint: Do 後面用原形動詞 have。

quiz.question: Did they ___ much snow last winter?
quiz.hint: Did 後面用原形動詞 have。

quiz.question: We did not ___ much rain here last month.
quiz.hint: did not 後面用原形動詞 have。

quiz.question: There is not much ___ in our town in winter.
quiz.hint: There is not much 後接不可數名詞 snow。

quiz.question: There was a lot of ___ here during the storm yesterday.
quiz.hint: a lot of 後面接名詞 rain，表示雨量。

quiz.question: Is there ___ rain in your town in winter?
quiz.hint: rain 是不可數名詞，詢問雨量用 much。

quiz.question: There are not ___ snowy days here in winter.
quiz.hint: days 是可數複數名詞，搭配 many。

quiz.question: We have ___ snow here in winter, but not enough to build a snowman.
quiz.hint: snow 不可數，表示有一點雪用 a little。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather outside at the moment?
quiz.hint: at the moment 表示現在；the weather 用 is。

quiz.question: ___ was the weather in your country last month?
quiz.hint: 題幹沒有 like，詢問天氣用 How。

quiz.question: It ___ sunny and warm near the sea yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去；It 搭配 was。

quiz.question: It often ___ in this town in May.
quiz.hint: often 表示習慣；It 搭配現在式 rains。

quiz.question: It ___ heavily here two days ago.
quiz.hint: two days ago 表示過去，所以用 snowed。

quiz.question: Does your country ___ much snow in winter?
quiz.hint: Does 後的動詞用原形 have。

quiz.question: Our country ___ very little rain last spring.
quiz.hint: last spring 表示過去，have 用過去式 had。

quiz.question: There ___ no rain here yesterday, so the roads stayed dry.
quiz.hint: There 搭配 be 動詞；rain 不可數，昨天用 was。

quiz.question: A: Does it snow here in winter? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: Does it 開頭的一般動詞問句，肯定簡答用 it does。

quiz.question: A: Was it rainy yesterday? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: Was it 開頭的過去式問句，否定簡答用 it wasn't。
